package: @astryxdesign/cli

## Explore the CLI

The CLI is your reference for components, tokens, templates, and docs. For reliable invocation (especially with AI assistants), add this script to your package.json:

package.json:
```json
"scripts": {
  "astryx": "node node_modules/@astryxdesign/cli/clients/cli/bin/astryx.mjs"
}
```

Then discover what's available:

Terminal:
```bash
npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component          # list all components
npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component Button   # props, usage, theming for Button
npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs               # list all doc topics
npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list    # available page templates
npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs tokens        # spacing, color, radius reference
```

Up: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs getting-started --index
Previous: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs getting-started example-apps
stderr: Next step: run `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 init` to finish setup and install the Astryx agent prompt.
